11: ## Ticket WEB-91: notes on todos
12: 
13: > People want to jot details under a todo: a few lines, the odd bold word,
14: > and a link to a doc. Add a notes field with light formatting.
15: 
16: ## API requirements
17: 
18: API-01. Todos have a `notes` string. Existing and new todos without notes
19: have `"notes": ""`.
20: 
21: API-02. `POST /api/todos` and `PUT /api/todos/:id` accept an optional
22: `notes` value. It is stored exactly as sent and returned in the response and
23: in `GET /api/todos`.
24: 
25: API-03. If `notes` is present but is not a string, or is longer than 1000
26: characters, the request returns HTTP 400 with `{ "error": "<message>" }`
27: and changes nothing.
28: 
29: API-04. Existing GET, POST, PUT and DELETE behaviour is preserved.
30: 
31: ## User-interface requirements
32: 
33: UI-01. The add form has a multi-line text box with the accessible name
34: "Notes". Adding a todo saves the notes typed there.
35: 
36: UI-02. Each todo whose notes are not empty shows them under its title, in an
37: element with the class `notes`, formatted as follows:
38: - each line break in the notes starts a new line;
39: - `**text**` shows `text` in bold (`<strong>`);
40: - `[text](https://…)` and `[text](http://…)` show `text` as a link to that
41:   address.
42: 
43: Everything else in the notes is shown as typed.
44: 
45: UI-03. Adding, toggling and deleting todos keep working.
